name: python-dotenv
goal: Load DOMAIN from a .env file into a Python script and see its value (example.org).

steps.title: Installed the package
steps.check: in the fork after the session: python -c 'import dotenv' exits 0

steps.title: Created a .env file that parses
steps.check: in the fork after the session: dotenv_values('/work/.env')['DOMAIN'] == 'example.org'

steps.title: Ran code that calls load_dotenv
steps.check: step log: a python run whose source contains load_dotenv exited 0

steps.title: Saw the loaded value
steps.check: step log: the output of a python run that calls load_dotenv contains example.org

env_probe: import sys; from dotenv import dotenv_values; sys.exit(0 if dotenv_values('/work/.env').get('DOMAIN') == 'example.org' else 1)
